A 20 mm-thick high-entropy alloy ingot containing 50 Fe, 30 Mn, 10 Co and 10 Cr (at%) was prepared using a vacuum induction melting furnace.
The ingot was subjected to multi-pass hot rolling to 5 mm. The initial and finish rolling temperature was 1130 ◦C and 1020 ◦C, respectively.
After that, the hot rolled band was annealed at 1100 ◦C for 1 h followed by water-quenching.
The annealed hot band was further processed to 0.80 mm by two-stage cold rolling involving first cold rolling reduction of 60 %.
